name: notebook
title: Notebook
description: An open notebook on the desk: ruled paper with a red margin, bound with a wire spiral, binder rings or a stab-stitched spine, its holes punched, more pages peeking out underneath. Text sits on the lines, and with a dog-ear it turns pages. Its closed sibling, `NotebookCover`, is a cloth-bound cover with a stitched spine and an elastic band.

a11y: A Notebook is a plain element (`div`; `as="section"`, `"article"` or `"figure"` with a label when it means more). The binding, holes, pages underneath and the fold are aria-hidden, pointer-events-none decoration.

`NotebookTurn` is a real button (Enter and Space), named by its content; pages that are not current are `hidden`, so a screen reader reads only the open page. Give the button a name that says where it goes ("Next: Tuesday").
Text is ink on paper (14:1). The tilt is under 0.3 degrees and zero in calm density. Calm density also drops the wobble of the ruled lines' hand-drawn variants.
Block spacing in multiples of 1.75rem (28 px) keeps text on the lines; margins that break the rhythm are yours to choose.
